//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the stat component. See ../README.md and button.json/card.json for the model. Three mutually-exclusive variants share one BEM block: default (icon + content), --hero/--hero-compact (centred big value + change line), --square (coloured tile, big number + decorative symbol + bottom label). Element names differ by variant: default+square use __number, hero uses __value. Goldens are the canonical snippets/statistics.html shape.

propsVocabulary.variant: hero|hero-compact|square — mutually exclusive; absent = default (icon + content) variant
propsVocabulary.color: primary|secondary|success|info|warning|danger — SQUARE only; the whole tile is the colour (pa-stat--{color} compounds with pa-stat--square)
propsVocabulary.iconVariant: primary|success|warning|info|danger — DEFAULT variant icon-tile colour (pa-stat__icon--{v}); NO --secondary
propsVocabulary.changeText: change-vs-period line text — pa-stat__change (hero + square fit-mode)
propsVocabulary.isSymbolPrefix: boolean — square only; render __symbol BEFORE __number (prefix currencies $847K) vs after (suffix 87%)
propsVocabulary.isFit: boolean — square only; fit-to-box + progressive-disclosure mode, emits data-pa-stat-fit (JS wraps children at runtime; SSR markup stays flat)
propsVocabulary.contextText: square fit-mode only — lowest-priority caption row (pa-stat__context)
propsVocabulary.icon: default variant — glyph rendered inside pa-stat__icon; presence switches default from the bare number/label shape to the icon + content shape

goldenConventions: Structural only — stat adds no attribute conventions like button's type. Slot content (icon glyph, text) is a plain token so the diff checks structural nesting, not rich content. data-pa-stat-fit is a PRESENCE flag (svelte emits ='', keen emits '') — normalized to bare; the JS-built __slot/__group/__meta wrappers appear only AFTER the hook runs, so SSR goldens stay flat. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. axis-1 reverse-check is scoped to block modifiers (pa-stat--*); element modifiers (pa-stat__icon--*, __change--*) are verified forward (feature produces → exists in CSS). The colour enum classes pa-stat--{color} exist in CSS only compounded with --square, but the reverse check matches the bare token so they are claimed here.

isFit.note: square-only JS-HOOK feature — emits data-pa-stat-fit (presence flag) and each wrapper's own hook plumbing (keen: an auto id + phx-hook; svelte: a display:contents host wrapper). That plumbing is emitted at SSR time but is genuinely per-framework and is the 'pre-JS-hook only' boundary the README carves out, so fit mode is intentionally NOT covered by a strict-compare scenario (it can't reconcile to one clean golden without editing the shared normalizer). The flat authored fit shape uses <span> for __number/__symbol (keen has a unit test locking this).

isSymbolPrefix.note: structural — reorders pa-stat__symbol vs pa-stat__number, no class

contextText.note: square fit-mode only — only rendered in the JS-hook fit shape (see isFit), so exercised by wrappers/tests, not a strict-compare scenario

icon.note: default variant; presence adds pa-stat__icon + pa-stat__content wrapper

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: pa-stat--* block modifiers in main.css that are NOT feature-driven props — added by pa-stat-fit.js at runtime. Listed so axis-1's reverse check treats them as legitimately unclaimed.
cssStateClasses.pa-stat--fit-wide: square fit-mode only — JS-toggled by pa-stat-fit.js once the tile is wide enough to flip to the horizontal banner layout; never hand-authored

cssStateElements.//: __slot / __group / __meta are built by pa-stat-fit.js at runtime (not in the SSR markup the wrappers emit), so no feature produces them; documented here for reference only.
cssStateElements.pa-stat__group: fit-mode JS wrapper around __number + __symbol (carries the computed font-size)
